summary.en:
- Topaz inflicts "Proof of Debt" debuff on 1 target which increases Follow-Up ATK DMG taken. Using Skill can reapply this debuff and let Numby attack once.
- Numby appears on the action order and attacks the target with "Proof of Debt". Numby gets advanced by 50% if its target is attacked by a Follow-Up ATK. All Topaz's attacks are considered Follow-Up ATKs.
- Topaz's Ultimate buffs Numby, allowing Numby to be advanced by any type of attacks for 2 turns.

details.en:
- S1 [[light-cone:worrisome-blissful]] provides good stat buff, can work for all Follow-Up ATK Hunt units and makes the wearer able to inflict a debuff: making the target take increased 24% CRIT DMG.
- E1 makes enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" take extra Follow-Up ATK [[stat:cd]].
